item.text: I’m tightening the contract around traversal: absent mapping subtrees will be processed recursively (so DELETE removes keys instead of leaking), DELETE directly inside any list/tuple is invalid, DELETE inside a mapping nested in a list removes that mapping key, DELETE cannot be a mapping key, tuples are copied recursively, and cyclic alias/object graphs raise `ValueError` rather than reaching `RecursionError`. I’ll encode these cases in hidden tests and remove the exact CLI-prefix assertion.
